wiki.title: Arturo Alonso
wiki.extract: Arturo Alonso-Sandoval (born January 7, 1999) is an American politician serving as a member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives from the 89th district since 2022. A member of the Democratic Party, he has served as House Democratic Caucus Secretary since January 2025. He has authored legislation on artificial intelligence regulation, including measures on election deepfakes and state agency AI inventories.
